# on_title_gain_usurpation: root = usurper, scope:title. on_explicit_claim_gain: root = claimant, scope:title, scope:transfer_type.
on_title_gain_usurpation = { on_actions = { ck_struggle_usurp_catalyst } }
on_explicit_claim_gain = { on_actions = { ck_struggle_claim_catalyst } }

ck_struggle_usurp_catalyst = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:title.title_capital_county.title_province ?= { geographical_region = ckworld_earth }

			every_character_struggle = {
				involvement = involved
				limit = {
					is_struggle_type = ck_struggle_terra
